section: Tax inventory: company, self-employed, contractor, non-resident and property taxes

section: Tax inventory: company, self-employed, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
label: Self-employed contributions
value: None compulsory: no social security contributions; super for yourself is voluntary (deductible within the concessional cap)
note: Federal; paid by: Sole traders and partners; legal basis: Superannuation Guarantee (Administration) Act 1992 ss 12, 16A; ITAA 1997 s 290-150; details: self-employed
source_title: Superannuation Guarantee (Administration) Act 1992 (compilation of 1 July 2026), sections 12 and 16A; Income Tax Assessment Act 1997 section 290-150

section: Tax inventory: company, self-employed, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
label: Contractor rules: no-ABN withholding, voluntary agreements, labour hire, super for contractors
value: 47% withheld if no ABN is quoted; 20% (or the payee's instalment rate) under a voluntary agreement; super guarantee for contracts mainly for labour
note: Federal; paid by: Businesses paying contractors; legal basis: TAA 1953 Sch 1 ss 12-55, 12-60, 12-190; TA Regulations 2017 ss 38, 70; SG(A) Act s 12(3); Fair Work Act s 15AA; ITAA 1997 Divs 84-87; details: contractor-rules
source_title: Taxation Administration Regulations 2017 (compilation of 27 August 2026), section 38 and the definition of 'top rate' in section 5; Taxation Administration Act 1953 Schedule 1 sections 12-190 and 15-10

section: Tax inventory: company, self-employed, contractor, non-resident and property taxes
label: Company tax (corporate income tax) and the multinational minimum tax
value: 30%, or 25% for a base rate entity (aggregated turnover under $50 million, no more than 80% passive income); 15% minimum tax for groups with revenue of 750 million euros or more
note: Federal; paid by: Companies; legal basis: Income Tax Rates Act 1986 ss 23-23AB; Taxation (Multinational—Global and Domestic Minimum Tax) Act 2024; details: company-tax-minimum
source_title: Taxation (Multinational—Global and Domestic Minimum Tax) Act 2024 (No. 132, 2024; latest version, as made 10 December 2024), sections 5, 6, 8, 10 and 12

value: No presumptive or flat-rate regime; concessions for small business entities (turnover under $10 million), assets under $20,000 written off at once, small business income tax offset

source_title: Income Tax Assessment Act 1997 (compilation of 1 October 2026), sections 328-110 and 328-180

value: National visa for up to 12 months for third-country nationals working remotely for employers or clients outside Greece; at least €3,500 a month net (+20% for a spouse or partner, +15% per child); visa fee €75
note: Self-employed people choose one of six e-EFKA contribution categories each year; the amounts are fixed sums, not a share of income.
source_title: Εθνικό Τυπογραφείο (Government Gazette): Νόμος 5038/2023, Κώδικας Μετανάστευσης, ΦΕΚ Α' 81/01.04.2023, art. 68 (digital nomads, residence title Ζ.1)

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Digital-nomad visa: after arrival
value: A 2-year residence permit for persons with sufficient resources (type Ι.8) while the conditions are met; no work for employers based in Greece
note: Self-employed people choose one of six e-EFKA contribution categories each year; the amounts are fixed sums, not a share of income.
source_title: Εθνικό Τυπογραφείο (Government Gazette): Νόμος 5038/2023, Κώδικας Μετανάστευσης, ΦΕΚ Α' 81/01.04.2023, art. 68 (digital nomads, residence title Ζ.1)

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Digital-nomad visa: tax consequence
value: No special tax regime: a nomad present in Greece for more than 183 days in any 12-month period becomes a Greek tax resident (art. 4 ΚΦΕ) and is taxed on worldwide income on the normal scale
note: Self-employed people choose one of six e-EFKA contribution categories each year; the amounts are fixed sums, not a share of income.
source_title: Εθνικό Τυπογραφείο (Government Gazette): Νόμος 5038/2023, Κώδικας Μετανάστευσης, ΦΕΚ Α' 81/01.04.2023, art. 68 (digital nomads, residence title Ζ.1)

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Application authority
value: Visa: the Greek consulate in the country of residence; residence permit: the Directorate for Aliens and Migration of the Decentralised Administration where the applicant lives; tax regimes (5Γ, 5Α): AADE; self-employed insurance: e-EFKA
note: Self-employed people choose one of six e-EFKA contribution categories each year; the amounts are fixed sums, not a share of income.
source_title: Εθνικό Τυπογραφείο (Government Gazette): Νόμος 5038/2023, Κώδικας Μετανάστευσης, ΦΕΚ Α' 81/01.04.2023, art. 68 (digital nomads, residence title Ζ.1)

section: Self-employed: calculated remuneration (reiknað endurgjald), 2026 minimums
label: Rule
value: People working in their own business must pay themselves a calculated wage, at least what they would earn doing the same work for an unrelated employer and not below the tax authority's minimum for their category; it is taxed like wages, with withholding tax, tryggingagjald and pension contributions
basis: Minimum monthly calculated remuneration by category
note: A selection of the categories A to H in the tax authority's 2026 rules; the annual amount is 12 × the monthly one (for example ISK 5,664,000 a year in category E(9)).
source_title: Skatturinn: Reiknað endurgjald 2026 (viðmiðunarreglur ríkisskattstjóra)

section: Non-residents: employment income
label: Residence test
value: Resident with 183 days or more in Ireland in the tax year, or 280 days over the tax year and the year before taken together (not resident with 30 days or fewer in the year); any part of a day counts
note: Double taxation agreements can relieve a non-resident's Irish employment income; Revenue reviews the employment article of the treaty in each case. A person who arrives intending to stay can also elect to be resident in the year of arrival.
source_title: Revenue: How to know if you are resident for tax purposes (published 24 November 2025)

source_title: Mehrwertsteuergesetz (MWSTG) Art. 10 and 25 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Residence permit for self-employment: EEA and Swiss nationals
value: Short-stay permit (up to 1 year) or residence permit if the professional and trade requirements for self-employment are met and commuting is not reasonable; permit numbers are capped and many are allocated by lottery
source_title: PFZG Art. 10, 15, 16; PFZV Art. 23 to 27; Ausländergesetz (AuG) Art. 13 to 30

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Residence permit for self-employment: other nationals
value: No permit for setting up as self-employed: work permits require a Liechtenstein employer's application (managers, specialists and qualified staff only); people already holding a residence or settlement permit may become self-employed
source_title: PFZG Art. 10, 15, 16; PFZV Art. 23 to 27; Ausländergesetz (AuG) Art. 13 to 30

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Where to apply
value: Ausländer- und Passamt (Immigration and Passport Office), Vaduz
source_title: PFZG Art. 10, 15, 16; PFZV Art. 23 to 27; Ausländergesetz (AuG) Art. 13 to 30

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Digital-nomad or freelance visa
value: None: there is no permit for remote work for a foreign employer or client
source_title: Ausländergesetz (AuG) Art. 13 and 20 (version of 12.06.2026)

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Tax residence test (SteG Art. 2 and 6)
value: Domicile in Liechtenstein, or habitual abode: any continuous stay of more than 6 months (from the first day); stays for education, care or holidays up to 12 months do not count
source_title: Finanzgesetz 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Art. 2 and 3; SteG Art. 2, 6, 23; tax treaties with CH and AT, Art. 15

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Taxation of new residents and permit holders
value: Residents are taxed on worldwide income and wealth; income and wealth from foreign real estate and foreign permanent establishments are exempt (progression reserved); there is no exemption period for other foreign income
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 6 and 15 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Social security of residents and people working in Liechtenstein
value: Compulsory AHV/IV/FAK for everyone resident or working in Liechtenstein (AHVG Art. 34)
source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit; AHVG Art. 34, 41 and 43

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Social-security agreements (note)
value: For EEA or EFTA nationals in a case limited to the EEA or EFTA area, Regulations (EC) 883/2004 and 987/2009 decide which state insures a person; there is no single agreement covering Liechtenstein, Switzerland and Austria together, so a case involving all three is split by state of work
source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Unterstellung

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Inbound regime: lump-sum taxation (Besteuerung nach dem Aufwand)
value: On application, for foreign nationals taking up residence for the first time or after 10 years abroad who do not work in Liechtenstein: 25% of annual living expenditure instead of income and wealth tax; Liechtenstein real estate stays subject to wealth tax; no time limit and no application deadline
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 30 to 34 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Inbound regime for employees or experts
value: None: incoming employees are taxed under the ordinary rules (the lump-sum regime excludes gainful activity in Liechtenstein)
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 30 to 34 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Non-residents: tax on employment income
value: Final source deduction set by the Steuerverwaltung; ordinary assessment at the national tariff from CHF 211,400 gross pay (or on request), with a 150% surcharge in 2026
source_title: Finanzgesetz 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Art. 2 and 3; SteG Art. 2, 6, 23; tax treaties with CH and AT, Art. 15

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Cross-border commuters from Austria: Liechtenstein source tax
note: the commuter is taxed in Austria, the state of residence
source_title: Finanzgesetz 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Art. 2 and 3; SteG Art. 2, 6, 23; tax treaties with CH and AT, Art. 15

section: Freelancers, the self-employed and new residents
label: Cross-border commuters from Switzerland
value: Taxed only in Switzerland; commuter status lapses after more than 45 working days a year without returning home for work reasons
source_title: Finanzgesetz 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Art. 2 and 3; SteG Art. 2, 6, 23; tax treaties with CH and AT, Art. 15

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Income and wealth tax (national tax) (Vermögens- und Erwerbssteuer (Landessteuer))
value: 0% to 8%; tax-free up to CHF 15,855 (single parents CHF 23,783, couples CHF 31,710)
note: National; paid by: Residents (worldwide income plus a 4% notional yield on net wealth); non-residents on Liechtenstein income; legal basis: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 6 to 22, LR 640.0
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Municipal surcharge on income and wealth tax (Gemeindezuschlag)
value: 150% to 250% of the national tax (150% or 160% for tax year 2025)
note: Municipal; paid by: Residents and non-residents with Liechtenstein real estate or a permanent establishment (not on the source deduction); legal basis: SteG Art. 75 to 77
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 75 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Other surcharges on income tax (solidarity, health or defence levies) (—)
value: None: the only surcharge on the national tax is the municipal surcharge (and the 150% surcharge for non-residents assessed ordinarily)
note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 1, 23 Abs. 5 and 75
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 1 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Church tax (Kirchensteuer)
value: None: the State pays the Roman Catholic Church an annual contribution of CHF 300,000
note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: LR 181.0 Art. 1 and 2; SteG Art. 1
source_title: Gesetz über die Ausrichtung von Beiträgen an die römisch-katholische Landeskirche

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Capital gains of individuals (shares, movable and immovable private assets) (Kapitalgewinne)
value: Exempt from income tax; gains on Liechtenstein land are taxed by the real-estate gains tax
note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 15 Abs. 2 Bst. m and o
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 15 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Real-estate gains tax (Grundstücksgewinnsteuer)
value: Income-tax tariff (Art. 19 Bst. a) on the gain, plus a 200% surcharge instead of the municipal surcharge
note: National; paid by: Seller of Liechtenstein land; legal basis: SteG Art. 35 to 43
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 35 to 43 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Withholding tax on dividends, interest and royalties (Couponsteuer (aufgehoben))
value: None: coupon tax abolished from 2011 (only pre-2011 reserves); dividends exempt from income tax
note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 15 Abs. 2 Bst. n, 24, 157 Ziff. 5 and 158
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 24, 157 and 158 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Rental income and pension income (Vermögensertrag, Renten)
value: Rent: not taxed (the 4% notional yield on the property is); AHV/IV pensions 30% taxable; occupational pensions in full
note: National; paid by: Residents; legal basis: SteG Art. 14 Abs. 2 Bst. e, 15 Abs. 1 Bst. a and 16 Abs. 2 Bst. d
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 14 to 16 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Non-resident tax on employment income (Quellensteuer / Steuerabzug)
value: Final withholding; ordinary assessment from CHF 211,400 (150% surcharge in 2026); Austrian commuters 4%; Swiss commuters exempt
note: National; paid by: Non-resident employees (withheld by the employer); legal basis: SteG Art. 23 to 25; Finanzgesetz 2026 Art. 2 and 3; DBA CH and DBA AT Art. 15 Abs. 4
source_title: Finanzgesetz vom 7. November 2025 für das Jahr 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Social insurance contributions (old age and survivors, invalidity, family compensation, unemployment) (AHV / IV / FAK / ALV)
value: Employee 4.9% AHV/IV/FAK + 0.5% ALV; employer 7.385% AHV/IV/FAK/VK + 0.5% ALV (ALV up to CHF 126,000)
note: National; paid by: Employees and employers; the self-employed (no ALV); legal basis: AHVG, IVG, FZEG, ALVG
source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beitragsansätze AHV / IV / FAK / VK (gültig ab 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Employer-only levies: family compensation fund, administration costs, health-insurance contribution, occupational accident premiums (FAK, Verwaltungskosten, Arbeitgeberbeitrag OKP, BU-Prämie)
value: FAK 1.9%; VK 0.585%; health contribution CHF 180.50 a month per adult employee (2026); accident premiums
note: National; paid by: Employers; legal basis: FZEG Art. 45; KVG Art. 24 Abs. 8; UVersG Art. 79
source_title: Regierung: Merkblatt Lohnabrechnung (Stand Januar 2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Self-employed contributions (AHV/IV/FAK Selbständigerwerbende)
value: 12.285% (AHV 8.25%, IV 1.35%, FAK 2.1%, VK 0.585%); CHF 368.55 minimum below CHF 3,000 income; no ALV
note: National; paid by: Self-employed; legal basis: AHVG Art. 41 and 43
source_title: AHV-IV-FAK: Beiträge aus selbständiger Erwerbstätigkeit

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Mandatory occupational pension (second pillar) (Betriebliche Personalvorsorge (BPVG))
value: At least 8% of the insured wage for old age, from an annual wage of CHF 14,700
note: National; paid by: Employers (at least half) and employees; legal basis: BPVG Art. 4 and 7
source_title: Gesetz über die betriebliche Personalvorsorge (BPVG) (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Corporate income tax (Ertragssteuer)
value: 12.5%; minimum tax CHF 1,800 (credited); top-up tax for large groups under the minimum-taxation law
note: National; paid by: Legal persons; legal basis: SteG Art. 1 Abs. 2, 61 and 62
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 61 and 62 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Municipal business or profit tax (—)
value: None: the municipal surcharge applies only to the income and wealth tax; municipalities receive a share of the national corporate tax
note: Municipal; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 75 Abs. 1; Finanzgesetz 2026 budget line 920.352.02
source_title: Finanzgesetz vom 7. November 2025 für das Jahr 2026, LGBl. 2025 Nr. 556, Landesvoranschlag; SteG Art. 75

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Simplified or flat-rate regime for small businesses (Saldosteuersatzmethode (MWST))
value: No flat income-tax regime; VAT net tax rate method up to CHF 5,024,000 turnover and CHF 108,000 tax
note: National; paid by: Small VAT-registered businesses (optional); legal basis: SteG Art. 14 Abs. 2 Bst. b and c, 16 Abs. 1 Bst. b; MWSTG Art. 37
source_title: Mehrwertsteuergesetz (MWSTG) Art. 37 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Formation duty and insurance premium levy (Liechtenstein, where Swiss stamp law does not apply) (Gründungsabgabe, Abgabe auf Versicherungsprämien)
value: 1% of capital above a CHF 1 million exemption (0.5% above CHF 5 million, 0.3% above CHF 10 million); foundations 0.2%, minimum CHF 200
note: National; paid by: Companies, foundations; insurers; legal basis: SteG Art. 66 to 69
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 66 and 67 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Swiss federal stamp duties (issue duty, securities transfer duty, insurance premium duty) (Eidgenössische Stempelabgaben)
value: Issue duty 1%; transfer duty 0.15% or 0.3%; insurance premiums 5% (2.5% single-premium life)
note: Swiss federal (customs treaty); paid by: Companies issuing shares; securities dealers; insurers (passed on to policyholders); legal basis: Swiss Stempelabgabengesetz (SR 641.10), applicable in Liechtenstein (LGBl. 2026 Nr. 315)
source_title: ESTV: Die eidgenössischen Stempelabgaben (Stand 1. Januar 2024); Kundmachung LGBl. 2026 Nr. 315

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Value added tax (Mehrwertsteuer (MWST))
value: 8.1% standard; 2.6% reduced; 3.8% accommodation
note: National; paid by: Businesses with turnover of CHF 100,000 or more; consumers bear it; legal basis: MWSTG Art. 10 and 25; VAT treaty with Switzerland
source_title: Mehrwertsteuergesetz (MWSTG) (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Regional or municipal sales tax (—)
value: None: VAT is the only general consumption tax; municipalities levy only the surcharge on income and wealth tax and fees
note: Municipal; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 1 and 75; MWSTG
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 1 and 75 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Excise duties (tobacco, beer, spirits, mineral oil) and automobile tax on imported cars (Tabaksteuer, Biersteuer, Spirituosensteuer, Mineralölsteuer, Automobilsteuer)
value: Swiss federal rates; automobile tax 4% of the vehicle value
note: Swiss federal (customs treaty); paid by: Importers and manufacturers (passed on in prices); legal basis: SR 641.31, 641.411, 641.51, 641.61, 680 (applicable under the customs treaty, LGBl. 2026 Nr. 312)
source_title: BAZG: Automobilsteuer; BAZG: Interneteinkauf: Steuern und Abgaben; Kundmachung LGBl. 2026 Nr. 312

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: CO2 levy on heating and process fuels (CO2-Abgabe)
value: CHF 120 per tonne of CO2
note: National; paid by: Producers and importers of fossil heating fuels; legal basis: CO2-Gesetz (LR 814.065) Art. 3; CO2-Verordnung Art. 5
source_title: CO2-Verordnung; CO2-Gesetz Art. 3

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Property tax (land and buildings) (—)
value: No separate property tax: real estate is part of taxable wealth (valued at income value, at least the tax valuation) and taxed through the 4% notional yield
note: National; paid by: Owners (through the wealth tax); legal basis: SteG Art. 9 and 12 Abs. 2
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 1, 9 and 12 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Property transfer charges (Grundbuchgebühr (Eigentumsübertragung))
value: No transfer tax; land-register fee 6‰ of the price (minimum CHF 200); mortgage registration 2‰
note: National; paid by: Buyer (land register entry); legal basis: Grundbuch- und Handelsregistergebührenverordnung (GbHr-GebV), LR 214.011
source_title: Grundbuch- und Handelsregistergebührenverordnung (version of 01.08.2024)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Wealth tax (Vermögenssteuer (Sollertrag))
value: 4% of net wealth is added to taxable income (notional yield) and taxed at the income-tax rate, plus the municipal surcharge
note: National; paid by: Residents; legal basis: SteG Art. 5, 9 to 12 and 14 Abs. 2 Bst. l
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 5 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Tax on transfers to non-exempt foundations and similar structures (Widmungssteuer)
value: 3.5% of the wealth-tax value of the transfer
note: National; paid by: The person transferring assets; legal basis: SteG Art. 13
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 13 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Inheritance, estate and gift tax (Erbschafts- und Schenkungssteuer)
value: None since 2011: inheritances and gifts are not taxed (they add to the recipient's taxable wealth)
note: National; paid by: —; legal basis: SteG Art. 1, 15 Abs. 2 Bst. c and 157
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 1, 15 and 157 (version of 01.01.2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Annual motor vehicle tax (Motorfahrzeugsteuer)
value: Cars from CHF 114.10 a year (by weight); motorcycles CHF 45.65 + CHF 11.40 per 100 ccm
note: National; paid by: Vehicle keepers; legal basis: Motorfahrzeugsteuergesetz, LR 641.51, Art. 11 and 12
source_title: Gesetz über die Motorfahrzeugsteuer (version of 01.10.2019)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Performance-related heavy vehicle fee (Leistungsabhängige Schwerverkehrsabgabe (LSVA))
value: Per tonne-kilometre; the tariff must lie between 0.6 and 2.5 Rappen (up to 3 Rappen for 40-tonne vehicles)
note: National; paid by: Keepers of heavy goods vehicles; legal basis: Schwerverkehrsabgabegesetz (SVAG), LR 641.81; treaty with Switzerland LR 0.641.891.011
source_title: Gesetz über eine leistungsabhängige Schwerverkehrsabgabe (SVAG) (version of 01.01.2025)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Tourist tax (overnight stays) (Kurtaxe)
value: CHF 3.50 per night in hotels; CHF 2.50 holiday homes; CHF 1.50 campsites
note: National; paid by: Guests (collected by the accommodation provider); legal basis: Verordnung über die Melde- und Taxpflicht bei Beherbergungen (BMTV), LR 935.201.1
source_title: Beherbergungsverordnung (BMTV) (version of 01.01.2024)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Dog tax (Hundesteuer)
value: CHF 20 to 100 per dog, set by each municipality; double for the second and each further dog (Schaan 2026: CHF 100 and CHF 200)
note: Municipal; paid by: Dog owners; legal basis: Hundegesetz Art. 10c (as quoted by the Schaan council)
source_title: Gemeinde Schaan: Gemeinderatsprotokoll vom 26. November 2025 (Hundesteuer 2026)

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Customs duties and import VAT (Zoll, Einfuhrsteuer (Schweizer Zollgebiet))
value: Swiss tariff (mostly per kg); duty or VAT under CHF 5 not collected; travellers CHF 150 VAT-free
note: Swiss federal (customs treaty); paid by: Importers and travellers; legal basis: Zollvertrag 1923 Art. 1; Swiss Customs Act and Customs Tariff Act (LGBl. 2026 Nr. 312)
source_title: BAZG: Empfangen von Briefen und Paketen

section: Tax inventory: every tax, levy and charge
label: Lump-sum taxation for new residents without gainful activity (Besteuerung nach dem Aufwand)
value: 25% of annual living expenditure, instead of income and wealth tax
note: National; paid by: Foreign nationals moving to Liechtenstein who do not work there (on application); legal basis: SteG Art. 30 to 34
source_title: Steuergesetz (SteG) Art. 30 to 34 (version of 01.01.2026)

basis: Annual income from employment and other income taxed on the general scale (after the NPD and allowable deductions), residents

section: Tax-exempt amount (NPD) 2026

section: Contractors: employee or contractor, and schedular payments
label: Tax test: employee or contractor (Inland Revenue)
value: Generally an employee if the payer controls how and when the work is done. Indicators: must do the work personally; told what to do, when and how; paid a set rate; can get overtime or penal rates; set hours; works at the payer's premises; the payer sets the standards
note: Schedular tax is a prepayment of the contractor's income tax, squared up in the annual return.
source_title: Inland Revenue: Employer's guide, IR335 (September 2026), pages 8 and 14-17

section: Contractors: employee or contractor, and schedular payments
label: Tax guidance: Interpretation Guideline IG 16/01
value: Common-law tests: intention, control, independence, fundamental (in business on their own account) and integration; leading case Bryson v Three Foot Six Ltd [2005] NZSC 34
note: Schedular tax is a prepayment of the contractor's income tax, squared up in the annual return.
source_title: Inland Revenue (Tax technical): Interpretation Guideline IG 16/01, Determining employment status for tax purposes (employee or independent contractor?), issued 8 March 2016, paragraphs 5-6

section: Contractors: employee or contractor, and schedular payments
label: Employment law: gateway test (from 21 February 2026)
value: A worker is a contractor if all criteria are met: a written agreement saying they are a contractor or not an employee; free to work for others; can choose when to work or subcontract; can decline extra work; had a chance to get independent advice. Otherwise the common-law test applies
note: Schedular tax is a prepayment of the contractor's income tax, squared up in the annual return.
source_title: Employment New Zealand (Ministry of Business, Innovation and Employment): Employee or contractor

Paid by companies. Income Tax Act 2007; GloBE rules added by the Taxation (Annual Rates for 2023-24, Multinational Tax, and Remedial Matters) Act 2024

section: Personal income tax (daň z príjmov fyzických osôb, § 15)
basis: Tax base (základ dane) from employment and business income, per year
note: New for 2026: four rates instead of two. The thresholds are 154.8×, 212.4×, 264× the subsistence minimum valid on 1 January (€284.13); monthly withholding uses a twelfth of each threshold (€3,665.28, €5,029.10, €6,250.86). Self-employed people with business income up to €100,000 pay 15% instead.
